description: Describe a table's columns in a registered foreign Postgres connection: name, data type, nullability, and default. Requires connection_name, schema, and table. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) — the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the column description is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Introspect one table's columns in a registered external Postgres database: each column's name, data type, nullability, and default expression, in ordinal order. The leaf level of foreign-database introspection - use it to learn a table's shape before writing a SELECT against it. Dispatches asynchronously and returns a job_id immediately; the column description itself arrives via job completion.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the column description — that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the job was queued — do not present job_id/status as the answer to 'what are this table's columns'. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the column description lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, present the columns as a compact type list (schema metadata, data_sensitivity 0.1) and use it to help compose a run_query SELECT against the table.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Describe a table's columns in a registered foreign Postgres connection.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: external_pg.invalid_params: missing connection_name, schema, or table. external_pg.connection_unknown: no connection registered under that name. external_pg.auth_failed / external_pg.permission_denied: the registered credential was rejected. An empty columns list means the schema.table does not exist or is not visible to the connection's role.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: external_pg.connection_unknown: run list_connections. Empty result: verify the schema/table with list_tables. external_pg.invalid_params: pass connection_name, schema, and table.
